name: Bordighera (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bordighera (a palm tree above a yellow lion on red) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI BORDIGHERA in brown beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Bordighera, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bordighera arms — palm tree above a lion on red, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI BORDIGHERA beneath the arms
